# Event ticketing platform

*Client industry: events | Completed: 2024-10-20 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p10*

## The problem
The client was a concert promoter overselling venues.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Next.js, card payments and recurring subscriptions, PostgreSQL, Redis. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project sold 11,000 tickets without a single oversell.
